page.title: 文末にちょこっと確認

analysis.summaryJa: 付加疑問は平叙文の末尾に短い疑問を添え、相手に確認や同意を求める形である。本文と反対の極性にし、本文と同じ助動詞と主語を受ける代名詞を使う。画像の青・赤の車両、イントネーションの矢印、I amに対するaren’t Iの特例を根拠に、形と話し手の確信度を扱う。
grammarPoints: 肯定文には否定タグ、否定文には肯定タグを添える
タグの助動詞は本文の時制・助動詞に一致させる
名詞主語はタグ内で適切な代名詞に置き換える
上昇調は実際の質問、下降調は同意を期待する確認になりやすい
I amの肯定文に付ける標準的なタグはaren’t I
visualEvidence: 青い肯定文車両と赤い否定タグ車両が反対の極性を示す
本文の名詞を代名詞に替え、同じ助動詞を選ぶ手順が図示される
赤い上向き矢印と青い下向き矢印で二種類のイントネーションが対比される
I’m early, aren’t I?がam not Iではない特別形として強調される
commonTraps: 肯定文の後ろに肯定タグを置く
本文とは異なる助動詞や時制をタグに使う
タグの中でも固有名詞を繰り返す
I’mの後ろをamn’t Iまたはam Iとする

questions.prompt: The orientation begins at nine, -------?

choices.A: isn't it
choices.B: won't it
choices.D: does it

questions.translationJa: オリエンテーションは9時に始まりますよね。
questions.explanationJa: 一般動詞beginsの現在形をdoで受け、肯定文なので否定タグdoesn’t itにします。
questions.focus: 肯定の一般動詞文とdoesn’t it

questions.prompt: Ms. Ortega has sent the revised quotation, -------?

choices.A: hasn't she
choices.B: doesn't she
choices.D: has she

questions.translationJa: オルテガさんは修正版の見積書を送っていますよね。
questions.explanationJa: 現在完了has sentを同じhasで受け、Ms. Ortegaをsheに替えます。

questions.prompt: The loading bay was not open this morning, -------?

choices.A: wasn't it
choices.B: did it
choices.D: was it

questions.translationJa: 今朝、搬入口は開いていませんでしたよね。
questions.explanationJa: 本文がwas notという否定なので、肯定タグwas itを添えます。

questions.prompt: Your guests can use the lounge, -------?

choices.A: don't they
choices.B: can't they
choices.D: can they

questions.translationJa: お客様はラウンジを利用できますよね。
questions.explanationJa: 助動詞canを保ち、複数主語Your guestsをtheyで受けるためcan’t theyです。

questions.prompt: I am listed as the project contact, -------?

choices.A: aren't I
choices.B: am I
choices.D: isn't me

questions.translationJa: 私がプロジェクトの連絡担当として記載されていますよね。
questions.explanationJa: I amの肯定文に対する標準的な否定タグは例外的にaren’t Iです。

questions.prompt: The invoices did not arrive yesterday, -------?

choices.A: didn't they
choices.B: do they
choices.D: were they

questions.translationJa: 請求書は昨日届かなかったのですよね。
questions.explanationJa: did not arriveを肯定のdidで受け、複数主語invoicesはtheyにします。

questions.prompt: This access card is yours, -------?

choices.A: doesn't it
choices.B: isn't it
choices.D: is it

questions.translationJa: この入館証はあなたのものですよね。
questions.explanationJa: be動詞isを使った肯定文なので、反対極性のisn’t itを付けます。

questions.prompt: The technicians will not need another permit, -------?

choices.A: won't they
choices.B: do they
choices.D: will they

questions.translationJa: 技術者たちは別の許可証を必要としませんよね。
questions.explanationJa: 本文のwill notを肯定形willで受け、techniciansをtheyに替えます。

questions.prompt: Mr. Chen attended the briefing, -------?

choices.A: didn't he
choices.B: doesn't he
choices.D: did he

questions.translationJa: チェンさんは説明会に出席しましたよね。
questions.explanationJa: 一般動詞attendedの過去をdidで受け、肯定文なのでdidn’t heとします。
questions.focus: 過去一般動詞の否定タグ

questions.prompt: There are two spare projectors, -------?

choices.A: isn't there
choices.B: aren't there
choices.D: are there

questions.translationJa: 予備のプロジェクターは2台ありますよね。
questions.explanationJa: there are構文ではタグにもthereを残し、肯定文をaren’t thereで受けます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct tag question about a confirmed reservation.

choices.A: The reservation is confirmed, doesn't it?
choices.B: The reservation is confirmed, is it?
choices.C: The reservation is confirmed, isn't the reservation?
choices.D: The reservation is confirmed, isn't it?

questions.translationJa: その予約は確定していますよね。
questions.explanationJa: is confirmedという肯定のbe文には、代名詞itを用いた否定タグisn’t itが対応します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct tag question about employees who have not registered.

choices.A: The new employees haven't registered, haven't they?
choices.B: The new employees haven't registered, have they?
choices.C: The new employees haven't registered, do they?
choices.D: The new employees haven't registered, has it?

questions.translationJa: 新入社員はまだ登録していませんよね。
questions.explanationJa: 本文がhaven’tという否定なので肯定のhaveを使い、employeesはtheyで受けます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct tag question after a past statement about Ms. Bell.

choices.A: Ms. Bell called the supplier, doesn't she?
choices.B: Ms. Bell called the supplier, did she?
choices.C: Ms. Bell called the supplier, didn't she?
choices.D: Ms. Bell called the supplier, wasn't she?

questions.translationJa: ベルさんは仕入先に電話しましたよね。
questions.explanationJa: calledは一般動詞の過去なのでdidを使い、肯定文にはdidn’t sheを添えます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct tag question about a policy that cannot be changed.

choices.A: This policy cannot be changed, can it?
choices.B: This policy cannot be changed, can't it?
choices.C: This policy cannot be changed, does it?
choices.D: This policy cannot be changed, could it?

questions.translationJa: この方針は変更できませんよね。
questions.explanationJa: 否定のcannotに対して肯定のcanを置き、policyをitで受けます。

questions.prompt: Choose the standard tag used after “I’m next on the schedule.”

choices.A: I'm next on the schedule, am I?
choices.B: I'm next on the schedule, amn't I?
choices.C: I'm next on the schedule, isn't I?
choices.D: I'm next on the schedule, aren't I?

questions.translationJa: 予定表では私が次ですよね。
questions.explanationJa: 肯定のI amの後では標準的にaren’t Iという特別な形を用います。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct tag question about two deliveries expected today.

choices.A: Both deliveries will arrive today, don't they?
choices.B: Both deliveries will arrive today, will they?
choices.C: Both deliveries will arrive today, won't they?
choices.D: Both deliveries will arrive today, won't it?

questions.translationJa: 2件の配送品はどちらも今日届きますよね。
questions.explanationJa: willを同じ助動詞で受け、複数主語deliveriesはtheyにします。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct tag question about an office that was not crowded.

choices.A: The office wasn't crowded, wasn't it?
choices.B: The office wasn't crowded, was it?
choices.C: The office wasn't crowded, did it?
choices.D: The office wasn't crowded, is it?

questions.translationJa: オフィスは混雑していませんでしたよね。
questions.explanationJa: wasn’tという否定のbe文には肯定タグwas itを添えます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct tag question for “The printer works now.”

choices.A: The printer works now, isn't it?
choices.B: The printer works now, does it?
choices.C: The printer works now, didn't it?
choices.D: The printer works now, doesn't it?

questions.translationJa: プリンターは今は動きますよね。
questions.explanationJa: 三人称単数の一般動詞worksをdoesで受け、肯定文なのでdoesn’t itです。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct tag question about the guests’ departure.

choices.A: The guests left before noon, weren't they?
choices.B: The guests left before noon, don't they?
choices.C: The guests left before noon, didn't they?
choices.D: The guests left before noon, did they?

questions.translationJa: 来客は正午前に出発しましたよね。
questions.explanationJa: leftはleaveの過去形なのでdidを使い、複数主語をtheyで受けます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct tag question after a negative present statement.

choices.A: The kiosk doesn't accept cash, does it?
choices.B: The kiosk doesn't accept cash, doesn't it?
choices.C: The kiosk doesn't accept cash, is it?
choices.D: The kiosk doesn't accept cash, did it?

questions.translationJa: その端末は現金を受け付けませんよね。
questions.explanationJa: doesn’t acceptという否定文の後ろには肯定タグdoes itを置きます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The conference starts at ten, doesn’t it?”

choices.A: The speaker is checking whether the conference starts at ten.
choices.B: The speaker is announcing a new starting time of ten.
choices.C: The conference definitely ended at ten.
choices.D: The speaker wants the conference canceled at ten.

questions.translationJa: 話し手は会議が10時に始まるか確認しています。
questions.explanationJa: 付加疑問doesn’t itは、前の内容が正しいか相手に確認する働きをします。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The door isn’t locked, is it?”

choices.A: The speaker asks who locked the door.
choices.B: The speaker orders someone to unlock the door.
choices.C: The speaker is checking that the door is not locked.
choices.D: The speaker assumes the door is locked and forbids entry.

questions.translationJa: 話し手はドアに鍵がかかっていないことを確認しています。
questions.explanationJa: 否定文に肯定タグis itを添え、鍵がかかっていないという認識を確かめています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Ms. Rao has the access code, doesn’t she?”

choices.A: Ms. Rao has forgotten every access code.
choices.B: The speaker asks Ms. Rao to create a code.
choices.C: The speaker is checking whether Ms. Rao has the access code.
choices.D: No one knows who has the access code.

questions.translationJa: 話し手はラオさんが入室コードを持っているか確認しています。
questions.explanationJa: 肯定文にdoesn’t sheを添え、内容への同意・確認を求めています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The clients haven’t arrived, have they?”

choices.A: The speaker is checking that the clients have not arrived yet.
choices.B: The speaker states that the clients arrived early.
choices.C: The speaker asks when the clients departed.
choices.D: The speaker knows the clients will never arrive.

questions.translationJa: 話し手は顧客がまだ到着していないことを確認しています。
questions.explanationJa: 否定の現在完了にhave theyを添え、未到着という認識を確かめています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “We can extend the trial, can’t we?”

choices.A: The speaker seeks agreement that extending the trial is possible.
choices.B: The speaker refuses to extend the trial.
choices.C: The trial has already been extended without permission.
choices.D: The speaker asks who designed the trial.

questions.translationJa: 話し手は試用期間を延長できるという点への同意を求めています。
questions.explanationJa: can’t weは前の可能性に対する確認や同意要求を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “You didn’t receive my email, did you?”

choices.A: The speaker asks the listener to send a new email.
choices.B: The speaker checks whether the listener failed to receive the email.
choices.C: The speaker is certain that the email was opened.
choices.D: The listener confirms that the email contained an error.

questions.translationJa: 話し手は相手がメールを受信しなかったのか確認しています。
questions.explanationJa: 否定の過去文を肯定タグdid youで受け、未受信かを尋ねています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “I’m assigned to Room B, aren’t I?”

choices.A: The speaker assigns Room B to another person.
choices.B: The speaker refuses every room assignment.
choices.D: The speaker is checking that Room B is the assigned room.

questions.translationJa: 話し手は自分の割当先がB室であることを確認しています。
questions.explanationJa: aren’t IはI amの内容に確認を求める標準的な付加疑問です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The fee was included, wasn’t it?”

choices.A: The speaker asks how much the fee increased.
choices.B: The fee was excluded by a new policy.
choices.C: The speaker says that no fee ever existed.
choices.D: The speaker seeks confirmation that the fee formed part of the price.

questions.translationJa: 話し手は料金が価格に含まれていたことを確認しています。
questions.explanationJa: wasn’t itはwas includedという肯定内容への確認を求めます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “There won’t be a delay, will there?”

choices.A: The speaker announces that a delay is unavoidable.
choices.B: The speaker expects no delay and asks for confirmation.
choices.C: The speaker asks where a delay occurred yesterday.
choices.D: The speaker promises to delay the work.

questions.translationJa: 話し手は遅延がない見込みを相手に確認しています。
questions.explanationJa: there won’t beを反対極性のwill thereで受け、遅延なしという見込みを確かめています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Mr. Ali knows the route, doesn’t he?”

choices.A: The speaker is checking that Mr. Ali knows the route.
choices.B: The route is unknown to everyone.
choices.C: Mr. Ali is asking someone to draw a route.
choices.D: Mr. Ali has changed the route already.

questions.translationJa: 話し手はアリさんが道順を知っていることを確認しています。
questions.explanationJa: knowsをdoesで受けたdoesn’t heが、前の内容への確認を表します。

questions.prompt: I want to make sure we have the correct room. The training session is in Hall C, -------?

choices.A: doesn't it
choices.B: isn't it
choices.D: wasn't it

questions.translationJa: 正しい部屋か確認したいのですが、研修はCホールですよね。
questions.explanationJa: 現在のbe文is in Hall Cを否定タグisn’t itで受けます。

questions.prompt: You spoke with the courier this morning. The replacement package has not been delivered, -------?

choices.A: hasn't it
choices.B: did it
choices.D: has it

questions.translationJa: 今朝、配達業者と話しましたね。交換品はまだ配達されていませんよね。
questions.explanationJa: has not been deliveredは否定の現在完了なので肯定タグhas itを使います。

questions.prompt: The schedule says your flight leaves at 6:20. You will arrive at the airport by five, -------?

choices.A: won't you
choices.B: will you
choices.D: aren't you

questions.translationJa: 日程表では便は6時20分発です。5時までに空港に着きますよね。
questions.explanationJa: 肯定のwill arriveを反対極性のwon’t youで受けます。

questions.prompt: I may have written the number incorrectly. This extension belongs to Customer Support, -------?

choices.A: isn't it
choices.B: does it
choices.D: isn't this

questions.translationJa: 番号を書き間違えたかもしれません。この内線は顧客サポートのものですよね。
questions.explanationJa: belongsは一般動詞の三単現なのでdoesn’t itが対応します。

questions.prompt: The lobby is empty now. The visitors did not return after lunch, -------?

choices.A: didn't they
choices.B: do they
choices.D: did they

questions.translationJa: ロビーは今空です。来訪者は昼食後に戻らなかったのですよね。
questions.explanationJa: did not returnという否定文には肯定のdid theyを添えます。

questions.prompt: Before I print the badges, let me check one detail. I am on the attendee list, -------?

choices.A: am I
choices.B: aren't I
choices.D: isn't me

questions.translationJa: 名札を印刷する前に1点確認させてください。私は参加者名簿に載っていますよね。
questions.explanationJa: I amに対する標準的な確認タグはaren’t Iです。

questions.prompt: The storeroom key is missing. Mr. Ford took it yesterday, -------?

choices.A: didn't he
choices.B: wasn't he
choices.D: doesn't he

questions.translationJa: 倉庫の鍵が見当たりません。フォードさんが昨日持って行きましたよね。
questions.explanationJa: 過去の一般動詞tookをdidで受け、Mr. Fordをheに替えます。

questions.prompt: The invoice lists a service fee. That amount was not part of our original quote, -------?

choices.A: wasn't it
choices.B: did it
choices.D: was it

questions.translationJa: 請求書にはサービス料があります。その金額は元の見積りには含まれていませんでしたよね。
questions.explanationJa: was not partという否定be文に肯定タグwas itを置きます。

questions.prompt: The backup files are stored off-site. They can be restored within an hour, -------?

choices.A: can they
choices.B: aren't they
choices.D: don't they

questions.translationJa: バックアップファイルは別の場所に保存されています。1時間以内に復元できますよね。
questions.explanationJa: can be restoredを同じcanで受け、肯定文なのでcan’t theyです。

questions.prompt: We need an exact head count. There are twelve guests in your group, -------?

choices.A: are there
choices.B: aren't there
choices.D: don't they

questions.translationJa: 正確な人数が必要です。お客様のグループは12名ですよね。
questions.explanationJa: there areの肯定文にはaren’t thereを添えます。
